# JSON

Indent, minify and sort the keys of JSON.

Category: Formatters · ID: `json-format` · Search terms: json, pretty, minify, beautify, format

## Command line

```bash
devtooltui json-format [file|-] [flags]
```

## Inputs

1. Input

## Options

| Flag | Values | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--indent` | 0–8 | `2` | Indent. Spaces per level; 0 = minify |
| `--sort-keys` | on/off | `false` | Sort keys. |

## Examples

From the tests (`testdata/json-format`), so they are what the tool prints.

### array-indent2

Input:

```text
[
  1,

  2   ]
```

Output:

```text
[
  1,
  2
]
```

### nested-indent2

Input:

```text
{"zeta":true,"id":12345678901234567890,"name":"Café <b>&</b>","ratio":1.50,"exp":1e10,
 "items":[{"b":2,"a":1},[],{}], "nested":{"y":null,"x":[1,2,3]},"esc":"line\nnew \u00e9"}
```

Output:

```text
{
  "zeta": true,
  "id": 12345678901234567890,
  "name": "Café <b>&</b>",
  "ratio": 1.50,
  "exp": 1e10,
  "items": [
    {
      "b": 2,
      "a": 1
    },
    [],
    {}
  ],
  "nested": {
    "y": null,
    "x": [
      1,
      2,
      3
    ]
  },
  "esc": "line\nnew \u00e9"
}
```

### nested-minify

Input:

```text
{"zeta":true,"id":12345678901234567890,"name":"Café <b>&</b>","ratio":1.50,"exp":1e10,
 "items":[{"b":2,"a":1},[],{}], "nested":{"y":null,"x":[1,2,3]},"esc":"line\nnew \u00e9"}
```

### nested-sorted

Input:

```text
{"zeta":true,"id":12345678901234567890,"name":"Café <b>&</b>","ratio":1.50,"exp":1e10,
 "items":[{"b":2,"a":1},[],{}], "nested":{"y":null,"x":[1,2,3]},"esc":"line\nnew \u00e9"}
```

Output:

```text

    },

    {}

  "nested": {

  "ratio": 1.50,
  "zeta": true
}
```
